Vikas Kumar

T6-903, Ace Divino, Sector 1, Greater Noida West, U.P, India 201306

Mobile: +91-8010787568	Email: hbtisunny@gmail.com

Objective	

To secure a challenging and growth-oriented position in a dynamic and innovative organization. With over 11 years of experience in designing and developing large-scale, distributed software solutions, I aim to leverage my expertise in Microservices Architecture, Cloud Comput- ing, DevOps, High-Performance System Design, and AI-powered Search Platforms, I am passionate about creating scalable, reliable, and intelligent solutions while mentoring teams, implementing best practices, and driving technological excellence in software development.

Summary	

Over 11 years of experience in the IT industry, specializing in software design, develop- ment, and deployment.

Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices.

Hands-on experience in building AI-powered intelligent search platforms using Ollama, LangChain, MCP, Streamlit, and OpenAI Models for advanced document query resolu- tion.

Expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with re-ranking techniques to deliver precise, context-aware, and role-based search results.

Strong exposure to vector databases like Weaviate DB, enabling scalable, efficient se- mantic search and enterprise-grade information retrieval.

Strong understanding of cloud-native development, containerization, and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.

Expertise in developing scalable and resilient microservices architectures using service mesh patterns and API gateways.

Strong exposure to AWS services, like EC2, SNS, SES, S3, CloudFormation etc.

Deep knowledge of event-driven architecture, message brokers like Apache Kafka, and distributed transaction management.

Experience in performance tuning, optimizing system architecture, and implementing caching mechanisms.

Strong exposure to DevOps methodologies, including CI/CD pipeline development using GitLab, Jenkins.

Proficiency in relational and NoSQL databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Re- dis, and Elasticsearch.

Ability to lead and mentor teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best coding practices, and drive software quality.

Experience in integrating monitoring and logging solutions such as Grafana, Prometheus, and the ELK Stack.

Exposure to Agile and Scrum methodologies, ensuring seamless collaboration and effi- cient project execution.

Technical Skills	

Languages: Java, Python, Node.js

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Hibernate, Django, LangChain, LangGraph, OL- LAMA

Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Mon- goDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Weaviate

Web Services: REST, SOAP, GraphQL

Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), Kubernetes

DevOps:	Docker,	Jenkins,	GitLab CI/CD, Helm

Microservices:	API Gateway, Event- Driven Architecture

Tools: Eclipse, IntelliJ, PyCharm, Visual Studio Code, Postman

Version Control: Git, SVN, gitlab

Monitoring:	Grafana,	ELK	Stack, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry

Professional Experience	

Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs Pvt Ltd	Lead Engineer

Oct 2021 – Present

Led the design and implementation of microservices architecture for enterprise applica- tions.

Built an intelligent document search platform using Ollama, LangChain, MCP, and Ope- nAI models, delivering accurate and contextual query results.

Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with re-ranking and Weaviate DB, ensuring high-precision search and scalable knowledge retrieval.

Developed a secure, role-based interface in Streamlit, enabling efficient access control and seamless user interaction.

Designed scalable, high-performance solutions for distributed computing using Spring Boot and Kubernetes.

Developed event-driven applications using Apache Kafka, ensuring real-time data pro- cessing and fault tolerance.

Integrated API Gateway and Service Discovery mechanisms for seamless inter-service communication.

Implemented centralized logging and monitoring solutions using ELK Stack and Grafana.

Spearheaded CI/CD automation using Jenkins and GitLab, improving deployment effi- ciency.

Conducted code reviews, mentoring junior developers, and enforcing best practices.

In2IT Technologies Pvt Ltd	Project Lead (Java)

Jun 2017 – Oct 2021

Designed and developed telecom networking solutions using Apache NiFi and Kafka for real-time data processing.

Created hybrid databases combining Elasticsearch and TimescaleDB for scalable and efficient data storage.

Built microservices with high availability, using Redis for caching and Kubernetes for orchestration.

Automated deployments and infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Helm.

Led a team of 8 engineers, providing technical direction and ensuring project success.

Webbee eSolution Pvt Ltd	Sr. Software Engineer

Jul 2015 – Jun 2017

Developed and maintained enterprise eCommerce connectors, improving API integration capabilities.

Worked on cloud-based solutions using AWS and optimized database performance.

Developed RESTful services and third-party API integrations, ensuring seamless data exchange.

Sensible Mobiles Pvt Ltd	Associate Software Engineer

Nov 2013 – Jul 2015

Built Java-based advertising network applications with scalable backend architectures.

Developed REST APIs and optimized queries for efficient database interactions.

Projects	

MAPI GURU – Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs

Domain: Intelligent Search Platform

Technologies: Ollama, LangChain, MCP, Streamlit, OpenAI Models, RAG, Re-ranking, Weav- iate DB

Description: Built an AI-powered document search platform with RAG and re-ranking, en- abling secure, role-based, and highly accurate query resolution across enterprise services. ONEAPP – Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs

Domain: OSS/BSS

Technologies: Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, ELK Description: Developed a scalable microservices-based OSS/BSS platform enabling efficient telecom service management, real-time monitoring, and seamless integration with third-party applications.

CATS EA (Event Aggregator) – In2IT Technologies

Domain: Telecom Networking

Technologies: Apache NiFi, Spring Boot, TimescaleDB, Kafka, ServiceNow

Description: Built an event aggregation and processing system for telecom networks, inte- grating various monitoring tools and ITSM platforms to enhance incident management and resolution.

CATS Dashboard – In2IT Technologies

Domain: Telecom Networking

Technologies: PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Microservices, Kafka, Elasticsearch

Description: Designed and implemented a real-time data visualization platform that aggre- gates and displays network health and performance metrics for telecom infrastructure.

Education	

MCA, Harcourt Butler Technological Institute (H.B.T.I.), Kanpur – 70.25

BCA, Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut – 63.03

Certifications	

AWS Certified - Cloud Practitioner Certificate

Agile Certification - SAFe® For Team

Declaration	

I hereby declare that the above information is true and correct to the best of my knowledge.

Place: Noida	(VIKAS KUMAR)

Date: 29th Aug, 2025
